spanish: Y hizo Balaq como que habló Bilam, y subió Balaq y Bilam toro y carnero en el altar.

findings.issue: «como que» smooths the preposition+relative into Spanish; it can also sound like approximation or pretense, which כאשר does not require.

notes: 3ms verbs, singular animals, definite altar, and both names match the tokens; Balaq and Bilam are not locked in PROPER_NAMES.md.
